# https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/self-hosted

Source: https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/self-hosted

This section covers the operational tasks involved in running SurrealDB on your own infrastructure. For initial installation, see the [installation guide](https://surrealdb.com/docs/running/installation). For deployment architectures and container images, see [self-hosted deployment](https://surrealdb.com/docs/build/deployment/self-hosted/overview).
  * •
[Configuration](https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/self-hosted/configuration) — server startup options, environment variables, and storage engine selection.
  * •
[Backups & recovery](https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/self-hosted/backups-and-recovery) — export and import commands, backup strategies, and disaster recovery.
  * •
[Monitoring & observability](https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/self-hosted/monitoring-and-observability) — health endpoints, metrics, and tracing integration.
  * •
[Upgrades & patching](https://surrealdb.com/docs/manage/self-hosted/upgrades-and-patching) — version upgrades, the `surreal fix` migration tool, and compatibility notes.
